summary: OpenAI published a report describing usage patterns of students, teachers and parents using ChatGPT for learning outside the classroom, citing weekly conversation volume figures.

mechanisms.reason: The report cites large weekly message volumes for education-related usage, which is a usage statistic rather than a stated change in aggregate inference demand from a product or policy shift.
mechanisms.quote: prompts related to classwork and homework peak at more than 460 million messages per week during the school year
